resources.string: Rest a thumb on the trackpad, then turn the phone left or right and tilt it up or down. While this is on, holding a finger does not drag: to drag, hold Volume-down while you tilt, and let go to drop.
Tilt the phone to move the pointer while a finger rests on the trackpad. The motion sensor is read only then.
Shows the dials over other apps. Needs permission to draw over other apps.
Turn on Stay connected to keep the dials over other apps.
